details: Q_G is the designed one-time scale-free geometry ratio, not a repeated normalization.
Q_S and Q_R aggregate already bounded coordinates with geometric means; no z-score, percentage conversion, or second clamp rescales them.
D01 coherence is a bounded ratio before D04, but inclusion in Q_S is aggregation, not another normalization of coherence.
No [0,100], signed/unsigned, unit, time, integer/fraction, or percentage/fraction mismatch exists.

design_controls: state_support_ratio omitted to avoid reusing s,p,u,r
terminal decay omitted to avoid FMO/lifecycle time duplication
each selected D02 field appears once explicitly in D04 formula
upstream_dependency_coupling: D01 coherence c enters D01 strength s; D04 Q_S then contains both s and c.
D01 prior uncertainty lowers strength, while current uncertainty lowers Q_R.
D01 coherence affects uncertainty; uncertainty affects reversal propensity; Q_R contains both u and r.
double_penalization.interpretation: These are real coupled dependencies, so term independence cannot be assumed. Frozen design/implementation authority nevertheless defines them as separate D01 coordinates and reports no D04 double-count contradiction. Coupling may affect reachable distributions but is not classified as a proven penalty defect.

sign_semantics.input: Q_G, strength, coherence, persistence, each gate

d03_compression.closed_path: continuous differences below the D04 opening boundary are invisible to the terminal D03 target-rule branch; R31 consumes new_envelope_state=CLOSED
